## Reviewer's Guide

Adds CRUD-style methods to the tracked product service (remove, update, get, get_all) and ensures tag retrieval uses the initialization guard, improving data handling consistency and persistence logging.

#### Sequence diagram for tracked product update flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Caller
    participant TrackedProductService
    participant Storage

    Caller->>TrackedProductService: update(tracked_product_id, kwargs)
    TrackedProductService->>TrackedProductService: requires_initialization
    alt data_initialized
        TrackedProductService->>TrackedProductService: next(tp for tracked_products if id == tracked_product_id)
        alt tracked_product_found
            TrackedProductService->>TrackedProductService: tracked_product.update(kwargs)
            TrackedProductService->>TrackedProductService: set updated_at, increment version, set last_updated
            TrackedProductService->>Storage: _save()
            alt save_success
                TrackedProductService-->>Caller: True
            else save_failed
                TrackedProductService-->>Caller: False
            end
        else tracked_product_not_found
            TrackedProductService-->>Caller: False
        end
    else data_not_initialized
        TrackedProductService-->>Caller: False
    end
```
